---
title: "IPCEI DiD --- Intensity (total collaboration), entropy balancing"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(did)
library(dplyr)
source("_cs_helpers.R")
set.seed(42)
BSTRAP <- FALSE   # analytic/agg-bootstrap SEs for a fast exploratory pass; set TRUE for final
```

Entropy-balancing robustness for the intensity outcome (total collaboration).
Controls are reweighted so weighted covariate means match the treated means
(weights in column `w`, passed to `att_gt` via `weightsname`). One panel per
technology (no spec1/spec2). Mirrors `06_..._psm.Rmd`; outputs to
`results/ebal/intensity/`.

```{r paths}
PATH_BATTERY  <- "../data/battery_ebal_cs_ready.csv"
PATH_HYDROGEN <- "../data/hydrogen_ebal_cs_ready.csv"
OUT_DIR       <- "../results/ebal/intensity"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

WEIGHTS <- "w"     # entropy-balancing weights
XFORMLA <- NULL    # balancing already conditions on covariates
BITERS  <- 999
```

```{r load}
battery  <- load_cs(PATH_BATTERY)
hydrogen <- load_cs(PATH_HYDROGEN)
cat("battery :", n_distinct(battery$Linkedin_name), "firms\n")
cat("hydrogen:", n_distinct(hydrogen$Linkedin_name), "firms\n")
```

```{r estimate}
rows <- list(); es <- list()
for (tech in c("battery", "hydrogen")) {
  df <- if (tech == "battery") battery else hydrogen
  cs <- run_cs(df, "log_collabs",
               label = paste("ebal", tech, "total"),
               xformla = XFORMLA, control_group = cg_for(tech),
               weightsname = WEIGHTS, biters = BITERS, bstrap = BSTRAP)
  rows[[tech]] <- make_att_row_std(
    agg_simple(cs, BSTRAP), tools::toTitleCase(tech), "Total collabs",
    "Primary", cs_out = cs, df = df, yname = "log_collabs")
  es[[tech]] <- es_frame(cs, tools::toTitleCase(tech), "Total collabs", BSTRAP)
}
att <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(att, file.path(OUT_DIR, "att_summary_intensity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
esdf <- do.call(rbind, es)
if (!is.null(esdf))
  write.csv(esdf, file.path(OUT_DIR, "event_study_intensity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(att)
```
